task.pr_title: Issue 5616: Provide a way to remove all invalid recent repositories.

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Please use `RemoveInvalidRepositoriesAsync` instead.

Deleting each individual repo in current fashion is quite inefficient, as it will be opening and closing the underlying config for each deletion.
